audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's level chart was seven rows of 'Skill' while the content layer win[] and packet.levelChart both give Syndra six of seven stages.
audit.why: Syndra out-ranges Katarina at every lane stage (Dark Sphere 800, Force of Will 925) and Scatter the Weak answers the only engage tool Katarina has. The 54.66% win rate is earned by roaming and by the first-item reset spike, which is exactly the one row the content layer gives Katarina — the chart and the win rate do not actually contradict.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to the content layer row-for-row, with every why rewritten to state the Syndra-specific reason.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 3-5 Syndra's lane on Scatter the Weak; level 6 Unleashed Power (120/100/80s) beats a Death Lotus that can be Scattered mid-channel; first item is Katarina's flip; late Splinters of Wrath turns R into an execute.
audit.corrected: Spikes array is already grounded; only the E cooldown figure corrected from '~16s' to the kit's flat 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no digits, and dontsFull[2] warned about spell-shield kits — Syndra has no spell shield. dosFull[0] also implied a grounding interaction that does nothing here.
audit.why: Syndra has no dash, so Bouncing Blade's grounding flag is inert in this matchup and must not be sold as an interaction. The real cooldowns are Scatter the Weak flat 15s at all ranks, Dark Sphere flat 7s with a stored charge from Transcendent, Unleashed Power 120/100/80s. Death Lotus is flagged channel, so Scatter the Weak cancels it.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with all three real numbers; the spell-shield don't replaced with the live-Dark-Sphere warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells the reader that stacking MR is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Transcendent adds bonus true damage to Force of Will and Unleashed Power executes low-health targets, so raw resistances do not scale against her.
audit.corrected: Not written — the only sensible home is report[8].t and the report sweep is capped at two entries, both of which were spent on lint-flagged misgendering. Flagged here for the next pass.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eight misgendering findings (Syndra called he/his/him), two copy-paste bleeds, one cooldowns field with no digit.
audit.why: Lint computed them deterministically; champ-gender.js lists syndra as female.

edits.before: At 6 she gains the cleaner ult — Unleashed Power is undodgeable execute damage while your Death Lotus can be Scattered out of channel — so keep respecting her until she wastes E. The playbook: fake an engage to burn Scatter, count to two, then all-in with Q-E-R while she has no peel; that ~16-second window is the only fair fight in the lane. Shove with Q-W when she backs off and roam — Katarina's Shunpo ganks convert side lanes faster than Syndra's slow rotations, and your 54.7% win rate is built on those cross-map trades, not on out-laning her. Ward for her jungler; a sphere-stun plus gank is your death every time.
